findings.title: GitHub Actions is the only IaC family present (4 workflow files)
findings.detail:
**Surfaced facts** (per `families`, `ci-inventory`):

  - `.github/workflows/jetbrains-plugin.yml`
  - `.github/workflows/pages.yml`
  - `.github/workflows/vscode-plugin.yml`
- `gitlabCi` is empty: no GitLab CI configuration was found.

findings.title: Workflow inventory: four single-job pipelines
findings.detail:
**Surfaced facts** (per `ci-inventory`):

| Workflow name | Path | Job id | Triggers | Actions used |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CI` | `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | `build-and-test` | `workflow_dispatch` | `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4` |
| `jetbrains-plugin` | `.github/workflows/jetbrains-plugin.yml` | `build` | `workflow_dispatch` | `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-java@v4`, `gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4` |
| `Deploy site to GitHub Pages` | `.github/workflows/pages.yml` | `deploy` | `push`, `workflow_dispatch` | `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/configure-pages@v5`, `actions/deploy-pages@v4`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3` |
| `vscode-plugin` | `.github/workflows/vscode-plugin.yml` | `publish` | `workflow_dispatch` | `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4` |

Each workflow declares exactly one job.

**Implications** (inferred from the actions used, not from step contents, which were not surfaced):

- Two toolchains are set up in CI: Node (`CI`, `vscode-plugin`) and Java with Gradle (`jetbrains-plugin`).
- The job ids suggest the pipelines cover build/test, a JetBrains plugin build, a VS Code plugin publish, and a static site deploy. What the jobs actually run is not visible in the upstream output.

findings.title: Only the Pages deploy runs automatically; the other three workflows are manual-only
findings.detail:
**Surfaced facts** (per `ci-inventory`):

- `CI` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`), `jetbrains-plugin` (`.github/workflows/jetbrains-plugin.yml`) and `vscode-plugin` (`.github/workflows/vscode-plugin.yml`) list `workflow_dispatch` as their only trigger.
- `Deploy site to GitHub Pages` (`.github/workflows/pages.yml`) lists `push` and `workflow_dispatch`.
- No workflow lists a `pull_request` or schedule trigger.

**Implications:**

- As declared, the `build-and-test` job does not run on pushes or pull requests; it runs only when someone dispatches it manually. There is no automated CI gate declared in these workflows.
- The `publish` job in `vscode-plugin` being manual-only is consistent with a deliberate release step.
- Branch or path filters on the `push` trigger of `pages.yml` were not surfaced, so it is not known which pushes trigger the site deploy.

findings.title: GitHub Pages is the only declared deployment target
findings.detail:
**Surfaced facts** (per `ci-inventory`):

- `.github/workflows/pages.yml` has a `deploy` job using `actions/configure-pages@v5`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3` and `actions/deploy-pages@v4`.

**Implication:** the only hosting or deployment surface declared in the repo is a GitHub Pages site. Combined with the empty Docker, Helm, Kubernetes and Terraform inventories, nothing in the repo declares a server-side runtime environment or cloud resources.

findings.title: No container, orchestration, or provisioning IaC declared
findings.detail:
**Surfaced facts:**

- Docker (per `docker-inventory`): `dockerfiles` and `composeFiles` are both empty.
- Helm (per `helm-inventory`): `charts` is empty.
- Kubernetes (per `k8s-inventory`): `files` and `resources` are both empty.
- Terraform (per `tf-inventory`): `files`, `resources`, `modules`, `providers`, `variables`, `outputs` and `data` are all empty.
- This matches `families`, which lists only `github-actions`.

All of these tasks completed and returned empty inventories; none was marked unavailable.

**Implication:** the project is not packaged as a container image and declares no cluster or cloud infrastructure in this repository, at least within the scope S walk. Infrastructure managed outside the repo, if any, would not be visible here.
